OBJECT Codeunit 50100 All Rules Combined
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            RunDateL@1001 : Date;
          BEGIN
            // CAL001, CAL010, CAL020, CAL032, CAL033
            RunDateL := TODAY();
            ProcessEntries('ITEM-01', RunDateL);
          END;
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      UsedGlobal@1001 : Integer;
      ConfirmMsg@1002 : TextConst 'ENU=Proceed with %1?;RUS=Продолжить для %1?';

    PROCEDURE ProcessEntries@1(ItemNoP@1000 : Code[20];PostingDateP@1001 : Date;UnusedParamP@1002 : Boolean) Result : Decimal;
    VAR
      ItemLedgEntryL@1003 : Record 32;
      TotalQtyL@1006 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // CAL001, CAL002, CAL003, CAL004, CAL005, CAL010, CAL011, CAL012
      // CAL020, CAL021, CAL030, CAL031, CAL032, CAL033, CAL034
      UsedGlobal := 1;

      IF ItemNoP = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      ItemLedgEntryL.SETRANGE("Item No.", ItemNoP);
      ItemLedgEntryL.SETRANGE("Posting Date", PostingDateP);
      IF ItemLedgEntryL.FINDSET() THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          TotalQtyL := TotalQtyL + ItemLedgEntryL.Quantity;
        UNTIL ItemLedgEntryL.NEXT() = 0;
      END;

      IF (TotalQtyL > 0) AND
         (UsedGlobal > 0) THEN
      BEGIN
        IF CONFIRM(ConfirmMsg, FALSE, COMPANYNAME()) THEN
          Result := TotalQtyL;
      END;
    END;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,80,OnAfterPostSalesDoc,'',false,false)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnAfterPost@2(VAR SalesHeader@1000 : Record 36);
    BEGIN
      // CAL011: EventSubscriber warns only; CAL020: TESTFIELD has arg, FINDSET gets ()
      IF SalesHeader.FINDSET() THEN
        MESSAGE('%1', SalesHeader."No.");
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      Documentation must never be modified by rules:
      if a=b then begin end;
    }
    END.
  }
}
